nodes.name: openLCA Nexus
nodes.sector: Multi-provider, multi-sector LCA and sustainability data

relationships.evidence: The Commission node publishes representative products and background data for current PEFCR/OEFSR and EF frameworks.
relationships.constraints: Data stocks span EF generations and providers.
relationships.validation_question: Record EF method/reference-package version for every dataset.

relationships.evidence: Node records expose ILCD-format metadata, UUIDs and EF compliance declarations.
relationships.constraints: EF profiles add requirements beyond base ILCD.
relationships.validation_question: Validate against the applicable EF profile and reference package.

relationships.evidence: The public node uses the soda4LCA-style stock, browse, XML and ZIP service pattern.
relationships.constraints: Deployment customizations and software version were not captured on the landing page.
relationships.validation_question: Record deployment build and API profile.

relationships.status: Listed in the public openLCA Nexus catalog as of 2026-08-25
relationships.evidence: https://nexus.openlca.org/ws/dataproviders/8902 lists the asset and its openLCA-oriented database groups, datapacks or exchange formats.
relationships.constraints: Public provider/catalog claim only; account-gated or licensed package content was not accessed, and lossless import or calculation equivalence was not independently tested.
relationships.validation_question: For an explicitly accessible and licensed release, test the named package in a named openLCA version and record entity, reference, calculation and round-trip results.
